title: primula pumila
intro: Primula pumila, commonly known as Dwarf Primrose, is a low-growing, perennial plant species native to the Himalayas. The Primula pumila plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues and its anti-inflammatory properties, which can help soothe digestive issues and alleviate stress. The therapeutic actions of Primula pumila include its expectorant and antispasmodic properties, making it useful in treating coughs and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of the Primula pumila plant include iridoid glycosides and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
